title: Metadata Change Receipt
user: A photographer or small archive manager who needs to batch-plan and verify date, caption, keyword, and IPTC edits without trusting a black-box library import job.
smallest_useful_product: Local desktop-web workflow that accepts exported metadata CSVs, defines a field transformation, previews affected rows, and produces a signed before/after receipt plus exceptions CSV.
success_measure: At least 90% of a 10,000-row fixture's intended edits are represented exactly once in the receipt, and users can identify every exception without opening individual images.
constraints: Run entirely client-side; protect filenames/location data; clearly state that CSV verification does not prove pixels or embedded XMP were written.
